quests.briefing: Petyr the Boiler needs chemical neutralizing agents and copper scrap to descale the salt pans' main condenser coils before mineral crust causes a boiler explosion.

stages.text: Speak with Petyr at the Brine-Pan boiler shed to inspect the scaled copper coils.
Scavenge copper pipe fittings or chemical neutralizers from the collapsed salt mine galleries.
Deliver the descaling supplies to Petyr to restore boiler pressure.

quests.briefing: Milos the Riveter needs heavy forged rail anchors and high-tensile track bolts from the collapsed trestle at Span 44 to reinforce the settlement's perimeter barrier.

stages.text: Receive the tool specs from Milos at the Iron Siding rail forge.
Cut three structural rail anchors from the twisted steel trestle at Span 44.
Return the forged anchors to Milos at the anvil.

quests.briefing: Kira the Weaver needs a cask of distilled lantern oil or diesel fuel hauled to the lighthouse tower to keep the Fresnel beacon turning during heavy coastal fog.

stages.text: Talk to Kira in the kelp drying shed beneath Cape Beacon.
Secure a fuel cask from coastal caches or barter at trading posts.
Carry the fuel cask up the spiral stairs to the lighthouse watch room.

quests.briefing: Jarek the Blaster needs structural timber ties and steel shoring jacks hauled to Adit 3 to prevent a ceiling cave-in after a heavy blast cycle.

stages.text: Check in with Jarek near the powder magazine at Slate Hollow.
Gather sound timber props and steel jacks from abandoned warehouse ruins.
Wedge the timber props beneath the fractured slate roof in Gallery C.

quests.briefing: Tobias the Pilgrim seeks armed scouts to escort a group of vulnerable travelers past raider gully hides on the high Switchback Pass trail.

stages.text: Rendezvous with Tobias at the Pilgrim's Hearth courtyard.
Guide the pilgrim party across the icy scree slope, watching for ambushes.
Deliver the pilgrims safely to the Switchback Waystation shrine.

quests.briefing: Tess the Grease-Monkey needs copper alternators and automotive starter motors pulled from vehicle wrecks on the suburb bypass to repair the settlement's wind turbines.

stages.text: Get the tool wrench and salvage checklist from Tess at the grease bench.
Unbolt copper-wound alternators from vehicle chassis along the bypass road.
Bring the copper windings back to Tess for bench testing and rewinding.
